summary: Demon is the horned court of the Dominion: first of the sworn, envoys into the southern heat, an own road for those who weary of the oath, the Horned Host in the war, and a choice when the throne goes silent.

horned_throne.name: The Horned Throne
horned_throne.desc: Hazarel the Horned sits on a seat of black horn, and no one has ever sat in it but a Hazarel. The court has long since stopped asking whether the throne could be shared.

house_council.name: The House Council
house_council.desc: The Netherborn houses sit in a ring around the Horned Throne, and each speaks in turn. Hazarel listens to all of them, and mostly decides what he meant to decide in the first place.

first_into_the_storm_spirit.name: First into the Storm
first_into_the_storm_spirit.desc: Demon's levies march into the worst weather the Dominion can find, and they march in step. The court says that the storm was made for them, and the levies believe it.

cinder_trade.name: Trade with the Free
cinder_trade.desc: Cinder-iron and vent-glass go south through the free ports and come back as grain and silver. Hazarel pretends not to know, and the houses profit.

furnaces_of_demon_spirit.name: Furnaces of Demon
furnaces_of_demon_spirit.desc: The great furnaces on the cinder plain are fed from the vents and never let cool. The smiths work at them in shifts, and the ring of their hammers is never silent.

own_crown.name: The Horned Crown Free
own_crown.desc: The horned crown is raised in the great hall of Demon and set on Hazarel's head by his own hands. Demon answers to itself, and it has never felt so heavy or so light.

horned_court.title: The Horned Court Sits
horned_court.desc: The Horned Court sits in the hall of black basalt, with the horns of old kings above it and a fire in every brazier. Hazarel lifts a hand, and the court waits to hear which of its voices he will hear first.

southern_heat.title: Into the Southern Heat
southern_heat.desc: Demon's envoys walk south into the heat toward the court of the Nether, carrying gifts of black glass and a long list of questions. They come back with answers they keep to themselves.

silence_from_nafeher.title: Silence from Nafeher
silence_from_nafeher.desc: The summons have stopped. The Steward speaks in a name that does not answer, and what remains of the master of Nafeher, no one living can say.

focuses.name: The Horned Court
focuses.desc: Hazarel the Horned sits at the head of a long hall of black basalt, lit by braziers and hung with the horns of old kings. The court of Demon is the oldest in the Dominion, and the proudest.

focuses.name: Hazarel's Word
focuses.desc: Hazarel's word is law in Demon, spoken in a low voice and carried out without question. His seal is a horn pressed in black wax.

focuses.name: The Netherborn Houses
focuses.desc: The Netherborn houses keep their own halls, their own levies and their own ancient grudges. Hazarel gives each a seat at the court and a say in the council.

focuses.name: The Horned Throne
focuses.desc: The throne of horn is polished and raised on a dais, and the court agrees that Hazarel alone shall sit on it. The houses that disagree are given the chance to say so, once.

focuses.name: The House Council
focuses.desc: The houses persuade Hazarel to share the court with a council of their eldest. He agrees, and sits on the council's right hand.

focuses.name: The Court of Cinders
focuses.desc: The court moves to a new hall at the edge of the cinder plain, with black glass for windows and a floor of fused ash. Its fires burn from dusk until dawn.

focuses.name: First of the Sworn
focuses.desc: Demon was the first realm to kneel to Nafeher, and its lords take pride in having been first. Hazarel repeats the oath in the great hall, and the horns answer.

focuses.name: Netherborn Levies for Nafeher
focuses.desc: The Netherborn houses send their levies north in long black columns, and Nafeher counts them at the border. Demon sends more than it is asked, and is thanked for it.

focuses.name: The Dominion's Due
focuses.desc: Every year Demon sends its due to Nafeher in sealed chests of black iron. The tally is read aloud in the great hall, and the court is pleased.

focuses.name: First into the Storm
focuses.desc: Demon's levies drill in the worst weather the Dominion can find: black rain, ash-fall and thunder. They march out of it hardened, and ready for anything.

focuses.name: The Nether's Edge
focuses.desc: To the south the cinder plain ends in a heat that no one walks into lightly, and beyond it lies the court of the Nether. Demon's envoys go there on Nafeher's business, and are not always glad to be asked.

focuses.name: Envoys Below
focuses.desc: Azuth Cinder-Voice leads a party of envoys into the heat with gifts of black glass and a long list of requests. They return wiser, and thinner, and they keep their answers to themselves.

focuses.name: Old Portal Sites
focuses.desc: Scholars of Demon walk the burnt ground where the old gates once stood and copy what the fused stone remembers. What they find they study in silence.

focuses.name: The Bargain of This Reign
focuses.desc: Nafeher has chosen its approach to the court below, and Demon is asked to carry the bargain across the heat. The terms are written on a plate of black glass and the plate is not shown to anyone.

focuses.name: The Horned Crown Alone
focuses.desc: A few of the old houses say that the horned crown has been worn too long beneath another's banner. Hazarel hears them, and does not silence them.

focuses.name: Counsel of Cinders
focuses.desc: A council of the eldest houses meets in a hall of ash and discusses what a free Demon might look like. They end their meetings before dawn and burn their notes.

focuses.name: Trade with the Free
focuses.desc: Merchants of the free realms are admitted to the cinder markets and sold iron and glass at fair prices. The Dominion's tax is quietly forgotten.

focuses.name: A Court of Our Own
focuses.desc: Hazarel declares that the court of Demon is a court of its own, and need answer to none. The Dominion takes the declaration in silence, and the silence is the answer.

focuses.name: Cinder Forges
focuses.desc: Forges are raised on the cinder plain, drawing heat from the vents themselves. They glow through the long nights, and the sky above them is the colour of a hearth.

focuses.name: Vent Mines
focuses.desc: Shafts are sunk beside the vents to reach the cinder-iron below. The miners work in leather aprons and wet cloths, and are paid in double rations.

focuses.name: The Burning Roads
focuses.desc: Roads of fused glass are laid across the cinder plain, hot enough to dry the rain as it falls. Wagons roll over them in silence.

focuses.name: Furnaces of Demon
focuses.desc: A great furnace is raised at the heart of the plain, fed from a vent. It has not gone cold since the day it was lit, and the smiths who tend it say that it listens.

focuses.name: The Horned Host
focuses.desc: The horns are blown from the black hall, and the Netherborn houses answer as one. Within a night the cinder plain is full of banners.

focuses.name: The Netherborn Vanguard
focuses.desc: The Netherborn go north in the vanguard of Nafeher's host, tall in the saddle and impatient. The towns on the road shut their gates as the black columns pass.

focuses.name: Fire at the Gate
focuses.desc: At the old gate, the court of Demon lights great fires and calls across the heat. What answers is not described, but the levies that follow it are very large.

focuses.name: The Host Returns
focuses.desc: The host comes home in black columns, thinner than it left. Hazarel receives it on the steps of the great hall and counts every banner as it passes.

focuses.name: Silence from Nafeher
focuses.desc: The summons have stopped, and the black seals no longer arrive. The Steward speaks in a name that does not answer, and the court of Demon sits in a silence it has not known.

focuses.name: Stand with the Steward
focuses.desc: Hazarel decides that Demon's oath was sworn to Nafeher and that Nafeher still stands. The Steward speaks for it, and the Horned Court will follow the Steward's banner.

focuses.name: The Horned Crown Free
focuses.desc: Hazarel raises the horned crown with his own hands and sets it on his own head. Demon answers to itself now, and the court kneels to the only throne that speaks.

focuses.name: The Cinders Cool
focuses.desc: The war is over, and the fires of Demon burn lower. The court gathers in the great hall for the first time in a year and eats from a single table.
